about_the_game:
For fans of Cubed and Dangerous that want more Cubes and more Danger - Reshaped is a DLC focused on increasing the difficulty of the game, with improved swarm mechanics, enemy behavior and scaling. Of course to help compensate, build-crafting in the game has been completely revamped with a brand new set collection system and new collectable gear / perks.

Features

  • Set collection mechanic completely changes the way you'll evaluate gear and builds
  • Over 40 new items and perks to explore with alongside the originals
  • New instant perk type, trading long-term build power for instant rewards
  • New relics that interact with all the new systems
  • Enemy behavior improvements and optimizations, resulting in larger and deadlier swarms
  • Improved forging functionality, including option to replace all modifiers on a maxed item
  • Better level and campaign scaling systems to provide new challenges to all players
